question: On a fresh, previously unmeasured public 20-bit prime-order curve, does the opt-in cache-line pair index and relation guard reduce the complete verified wall time of the current generic index-calculus incumbent while preserving every counted operation?

claims.text: Every measured execution recovers and verifies the planted discrete logarithm, and replay reproduces every measured record.
The candidate and incumbent have identical complete counted cost on every paired workload and round.
claims.if_supported: the layout changes native constants only; it is not a counted or asymptotic improvement
claims.if_not_supported: the candidate is not the same algorithmic work and no layout-only speed claim is admitted

claims.text: The cache-line layout lowers complete verified solve wall time relative to the frozen incumbent on the specified fp20 workload and hardware class.
claims.if_supported: a scoped generic-track native engineering speedup at fp20; no scaling, asymptotic, algebraic-track, or rho-beating claim
claims.if_not_supported: no full end-to-end speedup is established for this candidate

claims.text: The matched rho arm records the remaining distance to rho; the layout experiment does not claim to close it.

hypotheses.statement: Replacing the incumbent hash-map pair index and repeat guard with fixed cache-line buckets reduces native lookup overhead enough to reduce the complete solve wall time.
hypotheses.mechanism: A miss scans one aligned cache line with no hashbrown control/bucket indirection; batched lanes can prefetch the pure home address. Table emission order, relation stream, linear algebra, recovery, and counted operations are unchanged.

predictions.minimum_effect: in each of two independent L2 sessions, both the A/A-corrected per-operation wall interval and the complete total-wall 95% interval lie wholly below 1

data_seen.measured: prior stage split on different 28/32-bit curves; no measurements of this implementation or the fresh fp20 seed
incumbent selection on disjoint curve and target seeds
the consumed v1 runs failed at L2 and supplied no admitted performance data; the excluded diagnostic used different curve and target seeds

provenance.decisive_scope: fresh prime_search seed 20261101041 and target seed 20261101042 on two independent c8a.2xlarge L2 jobs after one successful infrastructure qualification

predictions.minimum_effect: exact ratio and interval [1,1], same seeds, no unpaired runs

provenance.decisive_scope: all candidate/incumbent pairs in both sessions

arms.description: Matched negation-map Pollard rho, retained as the generic ECDLP reference and gap measurement.
Current generic-track fp20 incumbent: prime-abscissa size 45 and negation-folded MITM with the default map layout.
The incumbent with only oracle layout=lines, which also selects the equivalent cache-line repeat guard.
An identical incumbent arm under a second name for position bias and the wall-time noise floor.
Plain rho against negation-map rho: a known constant-factor slowdown through the same harness and timing detector.

positive.expected_detection: rho.plain has a complete total-wall 95% interval wholly above rho.negation in both sessions

negative.not_applicable_reason: the incumbent/incumbent-aa comparison is the matched empirical null for this one-factor performance claim; no separate scientific null population is asserted

factors.name: curve
factors.how: one fresh public synthetic curve fixed before measurement and distinct from the consumed v1 curve

factors.name: targets
factors.how: the same fresh target law and exact targets are crossed through every arm

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: one source revision, static ecbench binary, image digest, compiler and flags for all arms; observed hashes bind the export

factors.name: algorithm_seed
factors.how: ecbench derives the same seed for each arm in every workload and measured round from measurement seed 20261101043

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: alternate_measured interleaves arm positions within every round

factors.name: host_epoch
factors.how: two concurrent EKS Jobs with required pod anti-affinity; both must decide in the same direction and retain distinct Job/Pod/node identities

factors.name: host_state
factors.how: CPU model, node, affinity, isolation grade, blockers, steal, PSI and foreign busy ticks are recorded per execution; below-L2 rows are inadmissible

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: each execution is a fresh child process; eight rounds and two jobs repeat process placement and ASLR effects

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: ordinary non-resumable jobs; interruption is retained and the affected session is not a timed result

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: unblinded native analysis script and exact thresholds frozen before data; all sessions must pass

seed_derivation.note: ecbench's frozen plan derives algorithm_seed from measurement.seed=20261101043; the same workload/round seed is used for every arm and recorded

instance_sampling.rule: eight public targets from fresh target_seed 20261101042 on the fresh fixed curve

blinding.how: not masked: method records and exact parity checks reveal the representation; the native script and thresholds are frozen before data

power.note: Each session has 64 paired measurements per arm, and both independent sessions must separately put the 95% full-wall interval below 1. This is stricter than pooling; it is intended to resolve a repeatable native constant effect, not a minimum percentage effect. Four thousand bootstrap resamples are used by the fixed native comparison.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative scheduling estimate from prior disjoint fp20 prime-base sessions; v1 produced no admitted timing and no v2 seed has been executed

primary.name: complete verified solve wall time
primary.definition: ecbench solve interval for the whole cold method, including factor-base construction, oracle setup, relation collection, linear algebra, recovery and target verification
primary.source: records.jsonl time.solve_wall_ns; ecbench compare wall.total_wall_ratio and wall.total_wall_ci95
primary.resolution: 1 ns recorded; effective resolution gated by L2 and the same-session A/A interval

primary.name: complete counted GAE
primary.definition: all counted setup, relation, linear-algebra, recovery and verification group work

secondary.name: A/A-corrected wall per GAE
secondary.definition: candidate/incumbent ns-per-GAE ratio divided by the incumbent-aa/incumbent ratio
secondary.formula: (candidate ns_per_gae / incumbent ns_per_gae) / (incumbent-aa ns_per_gae / incumbent ns_per_gae)
secondary.resolution: double precision over integer clocks and counts

secondary.name: phase wall times
secondary.definition: setup, relations, linear algebra and verification phases reported separately as diagnostics; no phase decides the speedup

secondary.name: remaining gap to matched rho
secondary.definition: complete incumbent/candidate cost and wall time divided by rho.negation on the same public targets
secondary.formula: sum(method metric over paired rows) / sum(rho-neg metric over the same paired rows)

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The independent variable is a native memory representation whose intended effect is not represented by group-operation counts. Therefore complete wall time is the decisive metric, but only at L2 with same-session A/A correction, exact counted-cost parity, a positive timing control, and two independent host epochs.

stopping_rules.rule: Infrastructure stage: dispatch exactly one non-resumable taskq/deploy/eks-karpenter/l2-validation.json job on the exact tested commit. It qualifies routing and L2 only, contributes no candidate datum, and is not retried. If it fails or lacks a manifest-verified accepted L2 receipt, stop this evidence version before the tournament.
Scientific stage, conditional only on the fixed infrastructure qualification: submit exactly two concurrent independent jobs, each with 5 arms x 8 targets x (1 warmup + 8 measured rounds), then stop.

No scientific retry, alternate seed, factor-base retuning, load-factor tuning or selective host replacement after seeing a result. Any infrastructure or payload failure is retained and this version is inconclusive.

invalidation_rules: any wrong answer, missing replay, mismatched source/binary/spec hash, unpaired run or non-identical candidate/incumbent counted cost invalidates the speed claim
any measured row below L2, any restored timing interval, fewer than five admitted pairs, or A/A interval not containing 1 inside [0.9,1.1] makes that session descriptive
the positive rho control must be detected independently in both sessions
a stage-only improvement or one successful session is not a full end-to-end speedup
the infrastructure qualification is not candidate performance evidence and cannot be pooled with either tournament session
failure of the single infrastructure qualification terminates v2 without dispatching the two scientific jobs

decision_rule.text: C-wall is supported only if both independent sessions pass replay and controls, candidate/incumbent complete GAE is exactly 1 with interval [1,1], the same-session A/A-corrected wall interval lies wholly below 1, and the complete total-wall 95% interval lies wholly below 1. Otherwise the verdict is within_control_distribution, invalid_measurement, or inconclusive as applicable.
decision_rule.threshold: in each session: total_wall_ci95 upper < 1 and corrected_ci95 upper < 1; A/A contains 1 within [0.9,1.1]; positive control lower > 1; exact ops ratio 1
decision_rule.statistic: candidate/incumbent ratio of total solve wall and A/A-corrected ns per GAE, evaluated separately per session
decision_rule.interval: ecbench linearised paired t 95% intervals; 4,000 bootstrap resamples retained for counted summaries
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: total_wall_ratio and corrected_ratio, with reciprocal baseline/candidate speedup reported

inputs: two authenticated ecbench.session/v1 directories downloaded from their exact private S3 results URIs

graphs: candidate/incumbent complete-wall ratio with 95% interval for each independent session, alongside A/A and positive control
phase contribution diagnostic with full solve total emphasized

inadmissible: changing seeds, curve, targets, base size, load factor, number of sessions, rounds, thresholds or analysis after observing data
calling a relation-phase or setup-only improvement a speedup
pooling only favorable sessions or discarding contention not excluded by the frozen L2 rule
claiming a counted, asymptotic, algebraic-track or rho-beating improvement from a native layout result
treating a successful Kubernetes job or private S3 receipt as a performance verdict without running the frozen analysis on authenticated raw records
dispatching either scientific job after a failed or unverified infrastructure qualification
using the consumed v1 jobs, excluded local diagnostic, or infrastructure qualification as a v2 performance sample
